verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing claims it can capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync them to accounting software automatically. Card transactions are tracked in real time and synced to QuickBooks Online and Xero, which covers the coding side. However, the evidence never shows receipts being captured automatically when a card is used: 'capture receipts' may still mean a manual upload, and there is no detail on the mechanism. missing for 10: evidence that receipt capture is triggered automatically at card use with no manual upload, detail on how receipts are matched to transactions and auto-coded, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry

citations.quote: Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically.
track every transaction in real time
Relay syncs ultra-detailed, easy-to-understand transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero.
